record.question:
A company is retiring a photo-voting application deployed with CloudFormation. The teardown runbook will delete the stack. The original S3 bucket and all submitted images must remain immediately accessible. The RDS database needs only a restorable backup, and its compute must be removed. The stack deletion must complete without a custom process that empties or copies the bucket.

Which configuration meets these requirements?

options.text: Set the RDS DeletionPolicy to Snapshot. Enable replication to another S3 bucket, but leave the original bucket's DeletionPolicy as Delete.
Set DeletionPolicy to Retain for both the RDS database and the S3 bucket.
Set the S3 bucket's DeletionPolicy to Snapshot and the RDS database's DeletionPolicy to Delete.
Set the RDS database's DeletionPolicy to Snapshot and the S3 bucket's DeletionPolicy to Retain.

explanation.text:
<<4>> is correct. Snapshot saves the database data before removing the RDS instance, while Retain preserves the original bucket and its objects. The retained data and snapshot continue to incur storage charges.

<<1>> does not preserve the original bucket through the intended policy, and a nonempty bucket prevents automatic deletion rather than being silently removed. Replication also does not change the source bucket's deletion behavior. <<2>> leaves database compute provisioned. <<3>> requests an unsupported S3 snapshot policy and fails to preserve the database backup explicitly.

The lifecycle trigger is deletion of the stack, not deletion of a template file from source control. DeletionPolicy also applies when a resource is removed from a stack template during an update. For an old physical resource replaced by an update, configure UpdateReplacePolicy separately. A retained bucket remains outside the deleted stack's management scope.

AWS documentation (checked 2026-09-18):
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-updatereplacepolicy.html
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-rds-dbinstance.html

diagram_alt: Bucket retention preserves live objects, while an RDS snapshot preserves recoverable data without retaining the database instance.

sources.supports: DeletionPolicy governs stack deletion and removal of a resource, with S3 retention and snapshot support distinctions.
UpdateReplacePolicy governs the old physical resource when an update replaces it.
RDS instance deletion can preserve a snapshot while deleting instance compute.

editorial_notes: Separated actual stack deletion from deleting a template file and distinguished replacement policy from deletion policy.
Repaired the inherited claim that a nonempty S3 source bucket would be deleted automatically.
